text: AMCR, the Korean company behind the premium golfwear brand AmazingCre, was acquired in September 2024 by a consortium led by Grande Clip, the company builder founded by Woowa Brothers (Baedal Minjok) founder and former chairman Kim Bong-jin.
short: AmazingCre operator AMCR was acquired by Kim Bong-jin's company builder Grande Clip (September 2024).

source.name: Venturesquare: 그란데클립, 어메이징크리 인수 (Grande Clip acquires AmazingCre)
source.quote: 배달의민족(이하 배민) 창업자 김봉진 전 의장이 설립한 컴퍼니 빌더 그란데클립 이 프리미엄 골프웨어 브랜드 어메이징크리(Amazing Cre) 와 아이스버그골프로 유명한 ㈜에이엠씨알 인수를 마무리했다
source.note: Korean; translation: 'Grande Clip, the company builder founded by Baedal Minjok founder and former chairman Kim Bong-jin, has completed the acquisition of AMCR, known for the premium golfwear brand AmazingCre and Iceberg Golf.'
